sources.title: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10
sources.reliability: High for documented format; explicitly not a W3C Standard or Recommendation.
sources.evidence: JSON token interchange, groups, types, aliases/references, composites, typography, shadows, durations, and reference resolution.
sources.limitations: Format module delegates color representation to its Color module; tooling support varies.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.evidence: Text/non-text contrast, text resizing, reflow, focus not obscured, target-size minimum.
sources.limitations: Full conformance requires evaluating all applicable criteria and the complete experience.

sources.title: Variable fonts
sources.evidence: Variable-font axes for weight, width, slant, and optical size.
sources.limitations: Available axes, ranges, language coverage, and payload depend on the font file.

sources.title: font-optical-sizing CSS property
sources.evidence: Auto/none behavior and opsz axis for adapting glyph forms to rendered text size.
sources.limitations: Only applies meaningfully to fonts with an optical-size axis.

sources.title: clamp() CSS function
sources.evidence: Constrains a preferred value between lower and upper bounds.
sources.limitations: Chosen bounds still require zoom and content-length testing.

sources.title: Using container size and style queries
sources.evidence: Components can adapt to their containing context rather than viewport dimensions alone.
sources.limitations: Check specific query-type compatibility in the target browser matrix.

sources.title: oklch() CSS function
sources.version: CSS Color function; broad support since 2023-05 per MDN
sources.evidence: Oklab/OKLCH coordinates and CSS syntax; MDN reports broad availability since May 2023.
sources.limitations: Perceptual color coordinates do not establish WCAG contrast compliance.

sources.title: color-mix() CSS function
sources.version: CSS color-mix feature; broad support since 2023-05 per MDN
sources.evidence: Color mixing in different spaces; Oklab/OKLCH can be useful for perceptual mixing.
sources.limitations: Output still needs gamut, contrast, and browser rendering checks.

sources.title: prefers-reduced-motion CSS media feature
sources.version: Media Queries feature; broad availability since 2020-01 per MDN
sources.evidence: Detects user preference to remove, reduce, or replace non-essential motion; notes scaling and panning can trigger vestibular discomfort.
sources.limitations: Authors must design a reduced-motion experience; querying the preference alone is insufficient.

sources.title: backdrop-filter CSS property
sources.version: Baseline 2024; broad support since 2024-09 per MDN
sources.evidence: Applies blur/color effects to area behind transparent or partially transparent element; warns about older browsers.
sources.limitations: Does not guarantee low-device performance or readable contrast over arbitrary imagery.

sources.title: What's new in view transitions (2025 update)
sources.version: View Transition API status as of 2025 update
sources.reliability: High for Chrome platform information; cross-browser claims require per-feature checks.
sources.evidence: Summarizes same-document and cross-document transitions, Safari support, and Firefox 144 same-document support.
sources.limitations: Support differs by transition type and browser.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.version: Core Web Vitals guidance at cited revision
sources.reliability: High; official Google web performance guidance.
sources.evidence: Good thresholds LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1, evaluated at p75 for mobile and desktop.
sources.limitations: Article last updated 2024-10-31; verify metric set and thresholds again at implementation.

sources.title: Preload responsive images
sources.evidence: Responsive image selection, responsive preload, and high fetch priority for critical images.
sources.limitations: Preload can waste bandwidth if competing candidates or formats are preloaded.

sources.title: The video embed element
sources.evidence: Autoplay, muted, playsinline, poster, preload, and fallback behavior; notes unmuted autoplay is commonly blocked.
sources.limitations: Video accessibility may also require captions, controls, and alternatives depending on content.

sources.title: Dazzles: a luxury fashion archive rebuilt as an editorial React experience
sources.reliability: Medium; detailed first-party case study with live-site references.
sources.evidence: Dark editorial direction, named campaign worlds, brand lineage, responsive crop/order changes, appointment-oriented content architecture.
sources.limitations: Agency-authored; no independently supplied conversion or sales metrics.

sources.title: Silvia Tcherassi and WMT reimagine premier luxury ecommerce experience
sources.reliability: Medium; first-party case study with named client and implementation detail.
sources.evidence: Full-bleed photography, boutique-inspired textile/texture direction, mobile/desktop imagery, shoppable lookbooks, persistent product actions.
sources.limitations: Reported sales/conversion/session results are vendor-published; analytics and methodology are not supplied.

sources.title: Arqui9 Wins Awwwards Site of the Day
sources.reliability: Medium; first-party agency account of a named project and award.
sources.evidence: Balancing full-screen video, high-resolution renders, cinematic sequences, and a fluid experience.
sources.limitations: Traffic and visibility figures are agency-reported and not independently audited.
